debate.key_bull_argument: Strong confluence of trend-following indicators (supertrend, hull, psar bullish) with price above VWAP and extreme fear sentiment (VIX crisis) creates contrarian buy opportunity at support zone.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (RSI 73.34, Stoch 85.72) combined with absent crossover confirmation, bearish 50/200 EMA alignment, severe macro headwinds (VIX 396.64, rising dollar, flat yield curve), and weak fundamentals (no insider conviction, high earnings risk in 77 days) make continuation unlikely and pullback probable.
